## Purpose
What problem does this change address?

## Changes
Identify affected requirements, profiles, schemas and examples.

## Validation
State actual checks and results. Use not_run or unknown accurately.

## Impact and risk
Describe compatibility, security, claim language and migration effects.

## Decisions
Link the RFC or approval when required. Keep pending decisions visible.

## Clarity and evidence
Use the pinned ECS guidance for this repository. Preserve failed, not_run, and unknown results. Distinguish package tests from model-behavior tests. State whether the skill or manifest changed and whether the upstream source and license were reviewed.
